cells.code: which day has the highest average tip rate?
cells.html:
Group rows, calculate a percentage, then sort
df['tip_rate'] = df['tip'] / df['total_bill'] by_day = ( df.groupby('day', as_index=False) .agg(avg_tip_rate=('tip_rate', 'mean'), meals=('tip_rate', 'size')) .sort_values('avg_tip_rate', ascending=False) ) by_day['avg_tip_rate'] = (by_day['avg_tip_rate'] * 100).round(2) show_df(by_day)

In this dataset, Friday has the highest average tip rate at about 17.0%, but it only has 19 meals. That is a good moment to teach beginners to check group size before trusting a ranking.
